material.description: The recommendation supports possible inclusive civil-society participation in public policy and participation across policy/programme priority-setting, design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation in development co-operation and humanitarian assistance. These are possible roles, not universal duties or powers of every organisation.
material.locator: OECD/LEGAL/5021, Section II, recommendation 9; Section III, recommendation 2; Section IV, provisions on CSO effectiveness, transparency and accountability.
